findings.title: Voiced refuge against inward speech

findings.reader_payoff: The opening command becomes more than an instruction to repeat words: it makes the chosen appeal audible at the point where the later evidence places a competing hidden speech.
findings.containment: This remains an addition to the plain reading, “De: İnsanların Rabbine sığınırım.” It does not claim that voicing mechanically silences whispering, and it does not establish a surah-wide channel or a ranked interpretation.
